notes.title: Added cheat device and fixed bugs.
notes.content:
1. Add a new cheat device. Press the "." key on the keyboard to pop up the cheat menu.
2. Fixed the issue where language errors may occur when clicking to continue or re-entering the game.

notes.title: Fixes and additions
notes.content:
1. Fix a lot of bugs
2. Added a skipping function for each level

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
1. Level 1 adds a skip button, after the first spawn point.
2. Fix the bug that you can't continue the first level due to some reasons

notes.title: Added puzzle hints
notes.content: 1.Two new hints have been added to the fifth level.

notes.content: 1.Prologues are not automatically archived after they have passed

notes.title: Bug fixes and new additions
notes.content:
1. Fixed that when switching levels or re-entering the game, the language changed back to default Chinese
